items.title: Microduck Obstacle Avoidance: A Sim2Real Workflow with Isaac Lab and Newton
items.en_title: Microduck Obstacle Avoidance: A Sim2Real Workflow with Isaac Lab and Newton
items.en_oneliner: This hands-on walkthrough trains an obstacle-avoidance controller for the Microduck robot in Isaac Lab using ToF sensor data, then deploys the finished policy onto the real machine.

items.title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
items.en_title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
items.en_oneliner: Google is bringing Gemini into the Warriors' fan experiences and day-to-day operations at Chase Center, showing how AI works in a live sports setting.
